Tweet sentiment analysis

May 2024

Hyperparameter tuning

I collaborated on an Indonesian tweet sentiment-analysis experiment with text preprocessing, scikit-learn classifiers, and hyperparameter comparisons. The shared notebook documents the classification workflow and evaluation.

NLP
Notebook

Problem

Classify sentiment in informal Indonesian tweets and compare the effect of model settings.

My role

Collaborator on the shared sentiment-analysis and hyperparameter-tuning experiment.

Approach

Prepare tweet text, explore classifier configurations with Python and scikit-learn, and compare sentiment-classification reports.

Result

A shared Colab notebook for Indonesian tweet sentiment analysis, with model configuration and evaluation comparisons.
